description:
Engagement / activity signals for one email address.
When to use: When the user needs open/click-style activity for a specific address they already have.
Parameters: email — full email address to look up.
CREDITS: Each successful call spends ZeroBounce account credits. Confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked for validation, enrichment, or activity data.

email.description: Email address to get activity data for

name: get_activity
title: Get email activity
